scope: Durable node/agent enrolment, revisioned receiving-chat attachment and persistent scheduling across fresh native conversations.
migration: None. Session-derived development enrolments are not converted.
automatedCoverage: Lost credential reply retains one installation identity.
Competing attachment claims preserve one receiving generation.
A lost attachment reply fences new delivery until original-key reconciliation.
Archived-chat reconciliation does not rediscover or mutate original confirmed intent.
Definitive attachment refusal restores only a read-back-confirmed previous designation.
Old operation retries cannot reclaim a superseded receiver.
Fresh schedule firings resolve the replacement agent receiver after journal reopen and while execution is offline.
Uncertain old delivery is never replayed into the replacement chat.
Attachment fences a stale native admission snapshot transactionally.
A handover racing backend admission retries only after a definitive no-admission refusal.
Exact-session credentials cannot read or submit another chat's execution under the same agent.
Human confirmation is invalidated by switch, switch-and-return, reconnect, reload or disposal.
New-chat navigation preserves the original receiver claim across Home and creation/selection event reordering.

rootRegression.skipReason: Pinned Paperclip validator source is not installed.

limitations: Real native services, tools, daemon and TUIs, with a deterministic model and synthetic keyboard/navigation input.
No actual-human acceptance of the new enrolment or attachment commands is claimed.
No physical second-machine, complete crash-during-write matrix or offline replacement-attachment certification.
An unrelated plain OpenCode launch requires explicit attachment. Automatic fresh launches use the authorised Herdr/CLI launcher.
Development fixtures are isolated. These smokes do not enrol or replace the user's Wright conversation.
